scope: Only the owned CI workflow, validation runner, validation control tests, and static CI checker. Application accounting/source changes and product acceptance are outside this review.

reviewer_executed.check: Pure real offline_development_record over retained passing fixture and independent contradictory mutations
reviewer_executed.scope: No subprocess stubs needed; fixture logs and receipts use temporary directory only; all original production records preserved.

partition.count_policy: Partitions and extended selectors are not overlapping new suites or inflated unique test counts.

confirmed_design_checks.timeouts: Focused and offline-development commands600s; hosted execution steps15min and jobs30min. First noncandidate command timeout sets timeout_abort and leaves all subsequent required commands BLOCKED, attempted=false, explicit NOT_EXECUTED logs, so repeated command waits cannot consume the diagnostic reserve. Summary commands60s. Candidate full-suite command cap1800s remains unchanged.
confirmed_design_checks.union: All ten exact groups plus development required. Receipts bind current explicit passing state, absence of active/abort flags, exact source/Git/locks/runtime/selection, strict integer zero exits, correct600s limits, timed_out is False, exact command argv and cwd, and fixed sibling raw log hashes/byte sizes. Malformed absolute source/interpreter/output fields reject. No caller absolute path is used to read transferred logs.
confirmed_design_checks.development: All eight gates bind the real producer commands/source_root/output/interpreter. Product path and private output, frontend scripts/cwd, strict booleans for offline assertions, and source unchanged required. The before-fix active/timed-out loophole is closed and negative controls expanded.
confirmed_design_checks.timeout_cleanup: Private POSIX process session; TERM then KILL process group, including TERM-ignoring descendant even if direct child exits. Initial and after-KILL reap waits separately bounded5s; cleanup warning cannot createPASS. Explicit child-ready handshake proves SIGTERM-ignore installation before timeout in executed Linux control. Direct-child nonPOSIX scope only; no Windows descendant cleanup claim.
confirmed_design_checks.artifacts: Explicit fixed validator JSON/text allowlists, regular-file/symlink checks,4MiB per-file transfer bound,7day retention. No private-product result/archive/report/session/database upload. Aggregate result/runtime logs and diagnostic status upload under always() for incomplete union.
confirmed_design_checks.network: Hosted workload command paths use sudo unshare --net and setpriv drop root; Helius/GH/GITHUB env variables checked absent. Official action SHA pins, read-only contents permission, persist-credentials=false and full history retained. No local hosted isolation execution is claimed.

owner_execution_evidence_inspected.count_policy: Only final152; earlier129/149 runs not added.

owner_execution_evidence_inspected.acceptance_claim: No complete development or candidate acceptance; source changed during application work.

limits.local_unshare: Unavailable limitation; hosted command design statically inspected only

publication_condition: Keep this exact four-file identity or rebind review if owned bytes change; final source and complete applicable acceptance remain root-owned obligations.
